news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA was aligned on Abivax's NDA strategy and planned content. Abivax remains on track to submit by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Landmark Phase 3 ABTECT Maintenance Trial Results
news.summary: Obefazimod met the Week 44 clinical remission endpoint at 25 mg (+39.3%) and 50 mg (+40.3%) versus placebo, with no new safety signals reported by the company.

catalysts.label: NDA submission for obefazimod (UC)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided first NDA submission to the FDA by year-end 2026.

pulse: Abivax has positive Phase 3 induction and maintenance data in ulcerative colitis and a constructive pre-NDA meeting. The NDA is guided for late Q4 2026, which is the main near-term catalyst for the Mar-2027 call.
